parsed.note_claim: Some telcos blocked access to Discord while others did not, and Discord agreed to comply with safety demands.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Whether your connection is back depends on your carrier. Globe and DITO were still blocking Discord at the CICC's afternoon briefing, and no network has said since that it has lifted the block. Smart and Converge never applied it.
parsed.reason: The article confirms that blocking varied by carrier and that Discord committed to CICC demands to lift the ban.
